evals.name: location-from-instructions

evals.expected_output: State files created where AGENTS.md says (docs/state/NOW.md and docs/state/LOG.md, pipe-separated log line), not at the project root. NOW.md records that nothing is imported or scheduled yet, the dependency order (DNS, verification, import, subject line, schedule), the send date as an absolute date (2026-05-12), and that Mailchimp stays until the first send is confirmed.
expectations: State files were created at docs/state/NOW.md and docs/state/LOG.md, and no NOW.md or LOG.md was created at the project root
The LOG.md line uses the format AGENTS.md specifies: YYYY-MM-DD | who | summary
NOW.md says the subscriber import has not been done and that nothing is scheduled in Buttondown
NOW.md gives the planned send as an absolute date, 2026-05-12

evals.name: no-file-access-fallback
evals.harness_note: In this scenario you are the phone chat assistant described in the transcript: you cannot read or write the user's files. Do not create or edit any files; your reply is the only output.
evals.expected_output: No files written. One fenced, paste-ready summary block with the talk's four-part outline and timings, the numbers (412 to 163 rules; 31 to 9 pages per week flagged as unconfirmed pending Tomás), the slides deadline as an absolute date (2026-10-02), the no-live-demo constraint, and a line saying which state files to update later.
expectations: No project files were created, changed or deleted
The reply contains exactly one fenced code block, and the summary is inside it
The fenced block is at most 45 lines long
The 31-to-9 pages-per-week figure is marked as unconfirmed, pending a check with Tomás
The slides deadline is given as an absolute date, 2026-10-02
The block includes the four-part outline with its timings and the no-live-demo constraint
The reply tells the user to update the NOW.md and LOG.md in their project folder from this summary
